RWD Services did an excellent job replacing my old, rusted shut off valve and main water line when I had a leak. Great crew, especially Mike and Les.  They sure know what they are doing. Wonderful communication, efficient, very reasonably priced. I am so happy my neighbor referred them and have already referred them to another neighbor that can’t access her shut off valve. I won’t hesitate to use them again.
Thanks RWD Services!

RWD did a great job with my house! I needed all of the water and sewer lines replaced. They dug tunnels and worked hard to get my house back in order quickly. They communicated regularly and clearly about their progress, what challenges they encountered along the way, and about what was working at the end of every day. All in all, great experience. A job like this isn’t cheap, so going with an experienced and professional company like RWD is smart. Also, I was impressed to see that when they wer

I had a water valve rust out on me at my RV garage.  I called RWD and they were able to send a plumber out to identify the type of valve, size of pipe, etc.  The next day the came out and replaced the valve.  They cleaned up at the repair site.  They were prompt.  Their people were courteous, friendly, and professional.  I do highly recommend them.

As a person with foundation repair, old plumbing, etc. I will recommend RWD 100 times out of 100. They are the absolute best. They really do treat your home as if it were their own. Will always use RWD as long as I live in North Texas. A+ service every single time.

I never thought I’d be raving about a plumbing company but here we are! My husband and I have had the best experience with RWD. They had the best prices in the area and their customer service went above and beyond. The communication is top tier- Kaya and Carol were always available via text, email, or phone call to answer any of our questions or to provide updates. So, no only is their plumbing work superior, but their employees just make the whole thing stress free and seamless. Look no further

We have used RDW services twice now and have had great experiences both times.   They are responsive, have great communication and are extraordinarily respectful of your home.  They are our go to folks for plumbing services and we are completely comfortable referring them to our friends and family.

RWD services are very fair in their prices and are honest.  They will not try and upsell you a service you do not need. They inform you when they are on their way.  They are very knowledgeable about their skills. We have had them repair slab leaks and clean out our water lines. We recommend them for all your plumbing issues or slab leaks.

I have been using RWD Plumbing for many years. There isn’t a better one out there. They are always on time. Communication is outstanding with this company. They provide great service for a fair price. Thank you

RDW Plumbing is great. I have used them for multiple sewer leaks and recently had a leak coming from my upstairs bathroom. I called them first thing in the morning and they arranged somebody to be out that afternoon. They stand behind their work and go the extra mile. Everyone that I have interacted with including Carol, Brady and Michael are always helpful and responsive.
Ryan & Antonio did great work repairing our water pipe leak! They were professional and friendly. I would highly recommend RWD Services!

In 30 minute he called back and said he did not do this but referred me to RWD. My husband had just left town (yeah..). I called Sunday and Austin, Chase, and Eli came out the next morning. I wish I could give RWD 10 stars because the service I received was TOP NOTCH!

I received a water bill that was 3x times it normally is and went into panic mode. After calling a few plumbers, RWD was recommended to me by a neighbor and they came out the same day to figure out where the leak was coming from.

They did a great job finding the issue and quickly resolving it. Called on a Wednesday morning and my water line was fixed by Thursday afternoon for a resonable price. WOW!

From the office

We had a slab leak, and Mr. JR came right away even though we were a new customer. We had a quote within an hour, and paid less than we ever would have imagined. We cannot thank them enough! Super nice people.

I’m a realtor and RWD Services just completed a big plumbing project for my clients who were selling their home. They were the most reasonably priced and the quickest to be available and get the work done out of all of the companies that we compared to. Their customer service was incredible and they went above and beyond to make sure that all parties were satisfied. The quality of work was fantastic, they did a really great job! I will be referring them to all of my friends, family, and clients

RWD Services was recommended to me by my longtime plumber when he was not available.  We’ve used RWD Services twice for clogged drains/toliets.  They usually come the same day and are quick and reasonably priced.  The lady who answers the phone and the technicians who have come out both times are very nice to work with.  I’m glad I’ve found them.

I have never felt so good writing a check in this amount.  Because I know I could have easily been taken for $15-20k by people who would jackhammer my slab to fix the leak(s).  These guys know what’s going on.  Very professional, courteous and clean.  Explained everything perfectly and answered all my questions

RWD Services did a fantastic job from my initial call to their office through to the completion of the plumbing work.  The office team answered questions, scheduled us for their earliest date, and moved us to an earlier date when they had an opening.
The on-site repair team answered our questions, quickly diagnosed our issue, performed the work faster than we anticipated, and left the work area clean.  Everyone - in the office and on-site - was friendly and professional.  Thank you RWD Services

Mr Deweese and his company, RWD Services, repaired a cracked sewer pipe that drained from my house to the municipal system. Although his is a small business which doesn't have the marketing panache of many competitors, his service also was significantly less expensive than what others quoted; and - most importantly - the repair was done well and very quickly - with virtually no disruption of our home. I was very pleased.

I called RWD after I accidentally popped the fill tank cap... you can imagine the catastrophe. Water everywhere!! I had been trying to tweek it for a week getting only temporary results. I wanted someone local & someone who could fit me in as soon as possible. They came out within 2 hours and had that part replaced & all working perfectly within 30 minutes and has been ever since. RWD Services was hired to replace and reroute my entire home drainage to get rid of the old cast iron pipes.  Issues arose after foundation repairs (nightmares!).  Randy and his crew were very knowledgeable and responded to my calls.  The onsite crew were very attentive to keeping the inside of my home clean while they performed the necessary work.  It took them a little longer than expected but I would rather that than a rushed job that wasn't right.  I will definitely use them again if needed

I highly recommend RWD services! Their response time, repair time, and work were great. Their office staff and plumbers are also great. They are professional, caring, and courteous. It’s refreshing to find a service company that appreciates the business, is responsive, and then follows up afterwards with a phone call to check up on all details. I hope you never have the need but if you do, call RWD Services.🌟

I cannot say enough good things about RWD!!! I will use them from here on out.
-family owned
-honest
-quality work
-fair pricing
-great communication
-friendly and kind
-actually CARE about their customers!!

Satisfied customer!

Carol, in the office, responded quickly and was great to work with too.  I highly recommend this company. If needed, I will absolutely use RWD Services, Austin, and Eli

When they noticed an issue unrelated to plumbing at the house they informed me right away. That to me is above and beyond! For sure will use their services if needed in the future.

I have also had them repair other problems in the past.

We used RWD to locate and fix a slab leak this summer. They were incredible! They were able to re route the plumbing through the attic, and saved us thousands of dollars. They were professional, prompt, courteous and reasonable. We had 2-3 other bids which were much higher.
We highly recommend this company!

We've used RWD for several years and they are good people who do excellent work.  Austin and Chase just rerouted our AC drain and I marvel at how expert and efficient they were.  Can't recommend highly enough.

RWD Services, LLC did an amazing job on our broken water pipes. Very professional customer service, workers were on time and very efficient. They got the job done in a timely manner. This company set a high standard of excellence and I would highly recommend them.

What a great find RWD was for us. We found we had a slab leak and our first worry was the expense, followed by the concern that repairing it would disturb the slab and value of our home. But we had 3 skilled and helpful young men come here and they fixed it in one day, at not anywhere near the costs we had figured. House looks great, problem over. I would recommend RWD Services to anyone.

I can not say how much we appreciate everyone at RWD Services.  They went out of their way to make what was a horrible situation a good experience.  Mike and Ryan are very knowledgeable, honest and hard working.  The office staff is the most helpful and friendliest I think I have ever worked with anywhere.  I will only use RWD for all of my plumbing needs from now on.

We thought we had a slab leak. When we were referred to RWD Services, they had somebody out same day. It turned out to be a clog in our inside HVAC unit. The two technicians fixed our problem and only charged us a small fee for coming out. We will continue to use our RWD in the future.

Randy and his team replaced all of the old iron plumbing and moved it to my attic. They were timely with the work, great with their communication, and fair with their prices. The office staff were great about scheduling and helping with coordinating payments. Overall a great experience with an unfortunate plumbing situation. I have and will continue to recommend them to my neighbors.

I had a pipe leak/burst in my sprinkler system right before thanksgiving. Called RWD services and even though they were busy, they came out the same day.  Mike was quick to detect the issue and got everything fixed within the next day. After they were done working, they cleaned up their work area and everything was good to go. They quoted me a reasonable price for the job and I will definitely recommend them for any future jobs.

My husband and I were so impressed with their attention to detail as they worked so well as a team to complete a leak in our home . With Christmas right around the corner we couldn’t have been more grateful ! Thanks so much for a superb job !

RWD Services repaired a slab leak last summer. They returned this week to install a toilet that another company botched.  I can’t say enough good things about their technicians and their work. They are the best….very professional and gave a good explanation.   Austin along with another technician was the RMD tech.
